newsitem.title: FRANCE: No execution date on Credit Foncier - Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: No execution date on Credit Foncier - Arthuis.

text.p: There is no execution deadline for the wind-down of troubled French property lender Credit Foncier and any credible takeover proposal will be examined, Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Tuesday.
Arthuis also said in a speech to a parliamentary committee that he proposed to meet the committee again for an update on the Credit Foncier crisis in the second half of January.

"Naturally, if a suitor comes forward in the coming weeks with a plan which is credible on the industrial level as well as for the interests of the employees, I would look at it with the utmost attention," Arthuis told a parliamentary committee.
